description: Requirements, 2026 income figures (with family members), work rights, where to apply, key documents and legal decision deadlines for the main Spanish residence visas: Non-Lucrative Visa (nlv), Digital Nomad Visa (dnv), student visa, and family routes. Figures from the BOE: IPREM 600 euros a month; NLV 2,400 euros a month; DNV about 2,850 euros a month gross (200% of the 2026 minimum wage). If the user has a concrete case, offer personal_visa_assessment afterwards.

family_members.description: Family members joining, to calculate the income needed.

visa.description: Which visa. nlv = Non-Lucrative (passive income, no work); dnv = Digital Nomad (remote work).
